comment: Single manifest for the doc gates. Ceilings, includes, and exceptions live ONLY here; raising a ceiling requires a manifest diff plus a decision note (see AGENTS.md 'Editing these instructions').

exceptions.DSH_E2U: quoted in the corpus-revision notes as a misspelling of DSH_E2E_URL; declared nowhere by design
exceptions.DSH_E2_URL: quoted in the corpus-revision notes as a misspelling of DSH_E2E_URL; declared nowhere by design
exceptions.DSH_GW_AUTH: owned and declared by the separate dsh-go-gateway project; this client repo documents the deployment-layer switch without implementing it

wire_pin.comment: Reviewed declared-only endpoint constants: names DshRpcEndpoints declares that the pinned 0.1.5 Typert Remote surface does not register. scripts/verify_wire_pin.py fails if a listed name is not declared by DshRpcEndpoints (stale entry), fails if the pin registers one (drift re-opened, delete the entry then), and fails if flutter/packages/harness_adapter/lib/src invokes one (a call to a route the pin does not serve is a defect to remove, not an exception to keep).

declared_only_allowlist.session/history: 0.1.5 replaced the history read with `session/page`; the constant is declared for the pre-0.1.5 surface and has no call site.
declared_only_allowlist.subagent/history: 0.1.5 reads child history through `session/page` with the addressed child id; the constant is declared but unused.

release_suite.comment: The release workflows re-run the test suite before signing, so their package list is a second copy of the `flutter-test` gate in scripts/verify_all.py. scripts/verify_release_suite.py fails when a home skips a package that gate tests, when a home tests a package the gate does not name, and when a home runs no `flutter test` at all. Add a package in both places or neither.

ci.comment: The label a toolchain job must use. A Gitea runner's label schema (host or docker://<image>) lives in the runner's own configuration, outside this repository, so a workflow naming a host label is indistinguishable from one naming a container label — which is how the toolchain moved onto a developer machine with no error anywhere. scripts/verify_ci_container_jobs.py holds every listed workflow to this label; see .agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-11-container-ci-runner.md.
ci.image_tag_comment: The image build the container label must resolve to. docker/flutter-android.Dockerfile bakes this string into the image as DSH_CI_IMAGE_VERSION, and every toolchain job compares the two before any gate runs — a label repointed at another image then fails on its first step instead of quietly running the gates against a different toolchain. The registry and the digest the label pins by are deliberately absent: the leak rules reject internal addresses, and both live in the runner's configuration with the rest of the label. Rebuilding the image means changing this string; see .agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-12-ci-image-registry.md.
